description: The unary primitive-recursive class is generated by zero, successor and the two unpairing coordinates, and is closed under pairing of functions, composition and the following operation: from \(f,g\), define \(H(a,0)=f(a)\), \(H(a,t+1)=g(\langle a,\langle t,H(a,t)\rangle\rangle)\), then return \(q\mapsto H(u(q),v(q))\).
